sources.title: Nodal/Smad2 signaling sustains developmental pausing by repressing ...
sources.snippet: Furlan et al. show that TGF-β signaling, previously thought to be dispensable for pre-implantation mouse development, is essential for blastocyst diapause, a reversible state of embryonic dormancy. Nodal-Smad2 signaling is specifically required for survival of dormant embryos and embryonic stem cells by repressing Pparg, a master regulator of lipid storage.

sources.title: A Functional TGF-β/Smad Assay for Targeted Profiling of ... - MDPI
sources.snippet: We evaluated the HEK-Blue™ TGF-β Reporter Assay as a targeted method for assessing Smad-dependent reporter activity in DBM-derived materials. ECM proteins were extracted from cortical demineralized bone granules (DBG) using guanidine hydrochloride (GuHCl) or urea and quantified after extraction, dialysis, and sterile filtration.
